units.title: Ecosystem Interactions & Dynamics
units.drivingQuestion: How do ecosystems work, and how can understanding them help us protect them?

units.title: Ecosystems: Matter & Energy
units.drivingQuestion: What causes fires in ecosystems to burn, and how should we manage them?
units.notes: Photosynthesis, respiration and carbon cycling in ecosystems (fire); no grade-9 skill, nearest are grade 7.

units.title: Inheritance & Variation of Traits
units.drivingQuestion: Who gets cancer and why? What can we do about it?

units.title: Natural Selection & Evolution of Populations
units.drivingQuestion: How does urbanization affect nonhuman populations, and how can we minimize harmful effects?

units.title: Common Ancestry & Speciation
units.drivingQuestion: What will happen to Arctic bear populations as their environment changes?

units.title: Thermodynamics in Earth’s Systems
units.drivingQuestion: How can we slow the flow of energy on Earth to protect vulnerable coastal communities?

units.title: Structure & Properties of Matter
units.drivingQuestion: What causes lightning and why are some places safer than others when it strikes?

units.title: Molecular Processes in Earth Systems
units.drivingQuestion: How can we find, make, and recycle the substances we need to live on and beyond Earth?

units.title: Chemical Reactions in our World
units.drivingQuestion: Why are oysters dying, and how can we use chemistry to protect them?

units.title: Energy from Chemical & Nuclear Processes
units.drivingQuestion: How can chemistry help us evaluate fuels and transportation options to benefit the Earth and our communities?

units.title: Energy Flow from Earth’s Systems
units.drivingQuestion: How can we design more reliable systems to meet our communities’ energy needs?

units.title: Energy, Forces, & Earth’s Crust
units.drivingQuestion: How do forces in Earth’s interior determine what will happen to the surface we see?

units.title: Collisions & Momentum
units.drivingQuestion: What can we do to make driving safer for everyone?

units.title: Meteors, Orbits, & Gravity
units.drivingQuestion: How have collisions with objects from space changed Earth in the past, and how could they affect our future?

units.title: Electromagnetic Radiation
units.drivingQuestion: How do we use radiation in our lives, and is it safe for humans?
units.notes: Electromagnetic radiation and its effects; no grade-11 skill for the spectrum (nearest s.8.em-spectrum), s.11.optics loose.

units.title: Stars & the Big Bang
units.drivingQuestion: Why do stars shine and will they shine forever?
